quest.title: The Great Mountain Survey
quest.description: The environmentalist Esther and the expedition team with her were set upon by monsters while performing a mountain survey, with the larger part of her survey beacons being lost in the process. She is currently looking for someone who can get them back for her...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x300, Primogem x40, Hero's Wit x2, Mora x20000

dialogues.speaker: Esther
dialogues.text: This is terrible... What am I going to do...

dialogues.speaker: Traveler
dialogues.text: What's wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Esther
dialogues.text: It's my beacons! I've gone and left a whole load of them up on the mountain!

dialogues.speaker: Esther
dialogues.text: There's no way I can continue my research now... *sigh* And after all the money I spent on them, too...

dialogues.speaker: Traveler
dialogues.text: What exactly happened?

dialogues.speaker: Esther
dialogues.text: Well, I wanted to do some research into conditions on the mountain — the climate, the environment, and so on. So, I invested in an expensive set of survey beacons.

dialogues.speaker: Esther
dialogues.text: Then, I scaled the mountain with a team of explorers. I was just putting the beacons in place when we were set upon by a huge group of monsters — they came out of nowhere...

dialogues.speaker: Esther
dialogues.text: I didn't manage to grab them all before I left. The explorers insisted that we leave immediately.

dialogues.speaker: Esther
dialogues.text: They also said they're not going back up there any time soon... But what about my beacons? The monsters will smash them to pieces!

dialogues.speaker: Esther
dialogues.text: Can you go and collect them for me? Please, I promise they're very easy to find.

dialogues.speaker: Traveler
dialogues.text: Alright then...

dialogues.speaker: Esther
dialogues.text: Thank you a thousand times over! No, a million times!

dialogues.speaker: Traveler
dialogues.text: What's in this for me?

dialogues.speaker: Esther
dialogues.text: Oh, uh... a reward, of course! I'll make it worth your while, I swear...

dialogues.speaker: Esther
dialogues.text: So, thanks in advance.

dialogues.speaker: Esther
dialogues.text: Did you find my beacons?

dialogues.speaker: Traveler
dialogues.text: I did indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Esther
dialogues.text: Let me see... Yes, these are the ones, alright!

dialogues.speaker: Esther
dialogues.text: Ugh, look at the state of them... Those monsters clearly weren't gentle with them. But thankfully, they're not completely ruined.

dialogues.speaker: Esther
dialogues.text: *sigh* Still, I guess I won't be using them in the near future... Ah, can't be helped. I will have to make do with a smaller-scale survey...

dialogues.speaker: Esther
dialogues.text: I have some other beacons here. Could you set them up on the mountain for me?

response.speaker: Esther
response.text: ...Is that a yes? I'll take that as a yes! Thanks! I'll mark the spot on the map for you.

response.speaker: Esther
response.text: ...There. I've marked them all out. Just put the beacons in those general areas.

response.speaker: Esther
response.text: Make sure to put them up in high spots. The higher the altitude, the more accurate the survey.

choices.text: Why can't you do it yourself?

response.speaker: Esther
response.text: I don't dare... If not even a whole team of explorers could stand up to those monsters, I'm certainly not going back up there alone.

response.speaker: Esther
response.text: I can't find any other explorers planning a trip up there at the moment, but I also can't delay this indefinitely.

response.speaker: Esther
response.text: So, you're the only chance I've got. Seeing as you managed to fetch my beacons back so effortless last time, I think you're more than up to the task.

response.speaker: Esther
response.text: Thanks once again. I'll be sure to compensate you well!

response.speaker: Esther
response.text: Wait, let me mark the locations on the map for you...

dialogues.speaker: Esther
dialogues.text: Are all the beacons in place?

dialogues.speaker: Traveler
dialogues.text: Yes.

dialogues.speaker: Esther
dialogues.text: Wonderful, that is an enormous help. Take these — along with my thanks, once again, for everything.

dialogues.speaker: Esther
dialogues.text: Ugh, with so few beacons for the survey, who knows if I'll be able to turn up anything of interest...

dialogues.speaker: Esther
dialogues.text: There's no way this is enough beacons to survey the whole mountain...

dialogues.speaker: Esther
dialogues.text: This beacon is useless... So's this one...
